verdicts.reason: A is a straight proportional shrink of the original: the subline '400 pairs. Draw closes Thursday.' and the LIMITED badge are only a few pixels tall and can't be read, the headline is tiny, and most of the 320x50 canvas is empty purple, so nothing was actually rearranged. B rearranges for the banner, with a large, readable headline and a clear Enter Now button, but the shoe has shrunk to a trivial icon jammed against the LIMITED badge and button in a cramped right-hand cluster, and the subline wraps awkwardly onto three tiny lines. Neither is ship-ready, but B is less broken because its headline and call to action can be read.
